# Niels Qvist

Niels Qvist is a Professor and senior physician (overlæge) at Region Syddanmark who serves as a member of the steering committee for DANIBD, a Danish national quality registry for inflammatory bowel disease. He holds the qualification of dr. med (medical doctorate) [^src1].

Qvist's role in DANIBD places him among the clinical and medical leadership overseeing one of Denmark's major efforts to track and improve care for patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). During the 2022–2023 reporting period covered by DANIBD's 2023 documentation, the registry tracked 33,381 patients with IBD across five Danish regions, with biologic treatments (BMSL) administered to 10,523 of them [^src1]. The steering committee membership that Qvist holds represents the broader participation of medical professionals, surgeons, nurses, patient representatives, and epidemiological support staff from all Danish regions working together through the RKKP (Danish Clinical Quality Program) infrastructure.
